hypothesis: Capping the aggregate worker budget will let the pinned staged n=7 search complete useful exact stage-A/B work on the available WSL instance, providing evidence about the search family rather than failing during initialization.
rationale: Experiment 003 reached the controller but the documented six-fast-worker plus three-heavy-worker configuration was killed by global WSL memory exhaustion before one result completed. This run changes only process concurrency: one fast worker, one worker per heavy stage, and one nested process per heavy worker. The startup ordering proxy, candidate-generation families, exact pinned candidate scoring, metric, and evaluator remain unchanged.
expected_information_gain: Distinguishes a worker-capacity failure from whether the upstream search can generate and score candidates under the frozen k-server objective.
method: Run the unmodified pinned examples/search_n7_async_pipeline/search_n7_async_pipeline.py through research_tools/run_kserver_n7_bounded.py. The wrapper loads the script and narrows only its existing worker-budget constants to FAST_WORKERS_TOTAL=1, FAST_STAGE_A_WORKERS=1, FAST_STAGE_B_WORKERS=1, STAGE_C_MAX_CPUS=1, STAGE_D_MIN_CPUS=1, and one nested process per heavy worker; candidate scoring continues through research_tools/kserver_n7_search_main.py and the pinned canonical Potential. Use fork multiprocessing, timeout 1800 seconds, n-cpus 4, families seed_dense,mutate_ck4,mutate_proxy,mutate_timed,mutate_full, startup seeds disabled, and tag reproduce_n7_codex_bounded. Preserve checkpoint/events/final output and run the exact frozen taxi evaluator on any finalist.
metric: best full circle_taxi_k4_m6 violations_k from exact candidate scoring/evaluator
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A candidate below 3 on the exact pinned primary evaluator is finite benchmark progress toward the k-server objective, not a proof of the full conjecture; any apparent improvement requires clean reproduction, broader frozen metrics, and adversarial verification.

configuration.startup_baseline_scan: zero-valued edge-order proxy; complete pinned edge order retained

compute_budget.cpu: one fast worker; one worker for each heavy stage; one nested potential process per heavy worker

kill_condition: Stop at the documented 1800-second search timeout, at the first candidate that passes the exact frozen evaluator and is preserved for verification, or at a precise runtime/contract failure. Do not modify the pinned evaluator or metric.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if exact evaluator returns violations_k < 3; reproduction at 3 is baseline evidence

previous_best_comparison.previous_pipeline_result: pipeline-003 killed by WSL global OOM before stage-A completion
previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: search-stage result is informative only through exact candidate scoring

interpretation: Pre-registered resource-capped rerun; no candidate claim is made before execution.
recommended_next_action: If useful stage results or a candidate below 3 appear, freeze and independently verify them; otherwise preserve the failure mode and pause k-server work pending more capable compute or the missing reported candidate.
repetition_justification: This is a materially different runtime-capacity test after pipeline-003 failed before any completed score. It changes only worker concurrency to fit the available machine; the search family, seed, objective, metric, pinned evaluator, and exact candidate-scoring implementation remain fixed.
